meta.title: Pitch graph | E. Berke Karagöz
meta.description: Live pitch of your microphone and of audio playing in another tab, on one graph.

intro.title: Pitch graph
intro.description: Live pitch of your mic, and of any tab you share, on one graph.

controls.label: Inputs
controls.headphones: Use headphones, otherwise the mic also picks up the tab.

graph.ariaLabel: Pitch over the last 8 seconds. The mic is the blue line, the shared tab the orange line, the mic's nearest note the green band.

errors.micDenied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in the site settings and retry.
errors.noTabAudio: The tab was shared without audio. Share it again with “Also share tab audio” ticked.
errors.unsupported: Tab audio sharing only works in desktop Chrome and Edge.
errors.insecure: The browser only allows the mic and tab sharing on https or localhost. This page is open over plain http.

warnings.echoCancellation: Echo cancellation is still on. Readings may be less steady.
warnings.noiseSuppression: Noise suppression is still on. Quiet notes may drop out.
warnings.autoGainControl: Automatic gain is still on. Loudness may jump.
